sampling_model.design: The certificate-independent structural input fixes the legal action catalogue and costs and supplies the explicitly charged source oracle. Each selected protocol runs on fresh independent units; a distinct protocol is charged once, its law handle and exact support table are cached once, and positive labelled slices may be reused across concrete target branches.
sampling_model.units: Each SELECT draws a fresh independent unit from the target population, and all potential responses for that unit are generated by one recursive finite-discrete SCM compatible with \(G\).
sampling_model.treatment: RAND actions replace a node mechanism for all affected children, while CTF-RAND actions fix the value delivered to their catalogued child subset without erasing the unit's natural decision.
sampling_model.overlap: For a legal protocol \(S\), positivity is required exactly for each used event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\), and is decided from the exact support bit table returned by \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\). Events with unrecorded endpoints, uncatalogued assignments, conflicting values, or zero support are inadmissible; unused cells are unrestricted.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: None is required for the symbolic theorem. The source oracle returns an opaque complete-law handle and exact finite support, and every query and answer bit is charged; scalar-functional evaluation and empirical law estimation remain outside scope.

A Layer-3 distribution is realizable if and only if CTF-REALIZE returns a sample.
Theorem 1 gives singleton reduction for a connected ordinary target, Lemma 3 characterizes singleton feasibility by hedge hitting, and Theorem 2 proves NP-hardness.

Ordinary minimum-cost proxy experiment design admits weighted Max-SAT and integer-programming formulations.

body.tldr: A finite physical catalogue can contain many legal Layer-2.5 acquisitions, and complete identification may select different sources for different assignment and equality-type branches. The primary certificate therefore owns concrete branches \((j,\omega)\), not whole factors: complete generic acceptance is equivalent to a switching certificate with at most \(M=\sum_j|\Omega_j|\) nonempty records and no greater cost. This yields a finite, generally exponential bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\), an exact explicitly exponential optimizer and infeasibility decision with every source-oracle reply charged, a static fixed-factor obstruction, equality of optimum costs on the ordinary \(Q[S]\) image, and the positive binary cost separation. The old one-source-per-factor object survives only as a restricted uniform subclass; no polynomial certificate or bounded-treewidth runtime is claimed.

project_justification.gap: Complete counterfactual identification fixes its source collection in advance, physical realizability treats one source law at a time, and ordinary intervention design optimizes fixed \(Q[S]\) source families. None supplies an operational cost problem that charges source-law and support access while preserving assignment-dependent source switching.
project_justification.niche: The missing object is a certificate-independent physical interface with explicit support and a branch-indexed acceptance witness whose quantifier order matches complete CTFIDU\({}^{+}\).
project_justification.fill: The project supplies a charged source oracle, a switching normal-form equivalence with at most \(M\) branch records, a finite canonical \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) bound, exact exhaustive optimization and infeasibility, a fixed-factor obstruction, equality of optimum costs on the ordinary source image, and a fully specified positive physical separation.

body.related_work: Raghavan and Bareinboim (2025) define SELECT, RAND, CTF-RAND, and READ and prove CTF-REALIZE complete for physical sampling; their result determines realizability, not a minimum-cost collection or a charged source-support interface. Raghavan and Bareinboim (2026) prove CTFIDU\({}^{+}\) complete for a fixed collection of Layer-3 inputs, but do not exchange source choice across value assignments and equality types. The present normal form preserves that branchwise quantifier order. Correa, Lee, and Bareinboim (2021) provide unnesting and ctf-factorization from fixed sources. Kivva et al. (2022) establish positivity-sensitive generalized identification, while event-level physical slice positivity here is checked through the explicit support oracle. Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash (2025) optimize ordinary intervention collections under fixed \(Q[S]\) source-family semantics; the two-way embedding here proves equality of optimum costs after coalescing duplicate READ variants, not reverse equality for each certificate. The general physical object additionally permits edge-specific CTF-RAND actions, READ-conditioned reusable slices, precedence, and conflicts. Exact optimization is finite exhaustive in \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\). The former uniform-source optimizer applies only to the explicitly restricted one-source-per-factor subclass. The familiar \(H_k\) guarantee remains solely on the stated one-action, protocolwise-legality, factorwise-no-synergy cover subclass. No local bounded-treewidth compiler is claimed. Park and Lee (2026) supply the downstream counterfactual bandit setting, not an acquisition-cost theorem.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The branch count \(M=\sum_j|\Omega_j|\) can be exponential in the structural input, so the canonical bound \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) and exhaustive optimizer are not polynomial-size claims. The two-vertex graph \(u\leftrightarrow v\), \(u\to v\) shows why one source cannot generally be moved outside the assignment/equality quantifier: matching and nonmatching branches have different value-matching obstructions. Source-oracle support tables may also be exponential, with all accessed bits charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\). Measured ancestry rejects a READ of \(Y\) alone for natural \(X\to Y\) whenever \(X\) is required, and physical slice positivity rejects exactly a used conditioning conjunction having zero support.
body.honest_scope: The proved primary result is a branch-indexed switching certificate, a finite \(B_{\mathrm{sw}}\) bound, and exact oracle-backed cost optimization and infeasibility. The compact one-source-per-factor optimizer is only a restricted uniform-subclass result and is not equivalent to general complete acceptance. Measured ancestry and positive admissible source events remain explicit physical restrictions. The ordinary image preserves feasibility and optimum cost, but reverse per-certificate cost can decrease when READ variants are coalesced. The one-action approximation applies only under the explicit no-synergy cover restrictions. The project claims neither a polynomial certificate, a full-incidence compiler or treewidth bound, a scalar identifying-functional output, efficient numerical evaluation, compactness, conditional-query completeness, arbitrary partial-read completeness, mediator-depth fixed-parameter tractability, polynomial lower certificates, nor a global approximation ratio.
